decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted is restricted to the dates of 5th December 2016 and 2nd January 2017 inclusive. The temporary structures shall only be used by members of the public between the dates of 16th December and 31st December (inclusive but excluding 25th December) and the site shall be closed to members of the public between the hours of 22:00 and 07:00 during this time.

Condition : 2 - No playing of musical instruments or operation of sound amplification equipment in association with the development hereby permitted shall take place outside of the hours of 10:00 and 21:30.

Condition : 3 - The music or public address system noise levels in association with the development hereby permitted, when measured or predicted at 1m from the fa?ade of noise sensitive premises, shall not exceed 65dB(a) over a 15 minute period.
Condition : 4 - The measures in the Travel Plan received 25th October 2016 shall at all times be implemented as approved.

Condition : 5 - The event website shall provide a link to Transport for London's 'Plan a journey' webpage, and all tickets (electronic or paper form) shall be accompanied by the map of the site as submitted to the local authority by email on 21st October; which outlines various public transport routes to and from the site.

Condition : 6 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (  ) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
description: Erection of two temporary structures in the Walled Garden of Chiswick House: one marquee and one Big Top tent to be used to host a theatrical production of Cinderella during December 2016.
